name: Chat system
ownerWords:
keep monitoring all the usage patterns of the Chat feature for that day, and periodically refine the framework so same stupid errors don't happen again.
now, this is a common patter, i want you to deep-research what to do. i want it to be owned by Chat though, maybe in a Cron/heartbeat tab within it with semantic goal defined
goal: Every open plan step in every chat keeps moving: a live job works on it, an open For you todo links it, or the owner parked it (c64). A step counts as stuck once a second check-in in a row finds it stuck. No correction is given twice and no chat turn fails on sieun-pi code. 100% and 0 are the owner's words (c64, c75).

metrics.label: Open plan steps kept moving in the last 24 h, all chats
Chat turns failed by sieun-pi code

onMiss: Each missed metric gets a code fix this run, run after run, until green (c75); a report, a retry or a board edit does not count. steps_moving_pct: group the stuck_step_hours and stuck_after_checkin lines by why the check-in left the step stuck, fix the biggest group in the check-in brief, src/checkin-end-state.ts or the findings, with a test in components/user-history/test that fails before the fix, release :5182 and press Run now. repeat_corrections: a sev, make the rule hold in code or a test and record it with correction_add id. sieun_pi_breaks: reproduce the error, fix it with a test, release. The other precheck numbers are context; fix one only when it causes a miss. A cause outside this chat's code gets a job, or a For you todo naming whose it is.
